## Individual Memberships

Access to **ALL locations –** full facility with unlimited yoga and fitness classes. Two guest passes per month.

#### **1 Month Paid-in-Full Membership**

Paid-in-full option is non-refundable. This membership option is great for people in town for a short period of time or wanting to just try out a membership.

#### **$115**

[Purchase Online](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/138 "")

#### **Monthly Drafting Membership**

Drafts monthly from bank account or credit card. Monthly drafting memberships have a $45 initiation fee, and no cancellation fee. Traveling? There is a $5/mo freeze fee to avoid paying the initiation fee again.

#### **$94.99/mo**

(or $80/mo with crew membership – see details below)

[Purchase Online](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/133 "")

#### **3-Month Paid-In-Full**

For those that just need a pass during a season. Paid-in-full option is non-refundable. This membership can be frozen for $5/mo.

#### **$32** **0**

[Purchase Online](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/145 "")

#### **1 Year Paid-In-Full**

Committing to 1 year saves you $189 compared to monthly drafting! Paid-in-full option is non-refundable. This membership can be frozen for $5/mo.

#### **$950**

[Purchase Online](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/139 "")

### Add-Ons

#### Texas Climbers Coalition Donation

$1-$5/mo \| Draft $1 or $5 monthly and Crux will send it to TCC. To learn more about this organization that helps Texas climbers gain access and maintain climbing areas, please visit  [www.texasclimberscoalition.org](https://www.texasclimberscoalition.org/)

Member Perks

- Access to ALL locations for no additional charge
- Two (2) guest passes a month for ANYONE!
- Monthly member appreciation nights with free beer and local vendors
- Unlimited yoga and fitness classes
- Free use of saunas
- 15% off coffee and non-alcohol drinks at Spokesman’s Central and Pflugerville locations only
- Refer-a-Friend benefit where both parties get a $10 gift card upon new membership activation
- Bike Benefits where after your 10th time biking in, you get a $10 gift card
- Discounted member pricing for workshops, competitions, and climbing classes
- 20% discount on climbing shoes during demo nights
- Ability to freeze membership for $5/mo and no cancellation fees
- Free membership for any of your kids 5 and under
- Two Day Passes per Month to [The Blok](https://www.theblokclimbing.com/)

### Don’t forget about our Loyalty Points!

Anyone can earn 1 point per visit. Check out how you can redeem your points:

## “Come to Crux” Package

This is our intro offer for all guests trying to decide if a membership is the right fit for them. With this package you get access to full facility including yoga and fitness classes, saunas, locker rooms, and gear rental.

Passes can only be used at one location per day. These passes cannot be shared and must be used within 30 days. **You can only purchase this pass once, so it must be done in-person!**

## Crew Memberships

These are our lowest and best rates. No discounts can apply to these crews memberships. Crew memberships start with two people on one membership, drafting or paying with the same card. You can add crew members to drop your rate even lower!

#### **2 Person Crew Paid-in-Full Year Membership**

Access to full facility including unlimited yoga and fitness classes. Two guest passes per month.

**$1650**

Paid-in-full option is non-refundable and includes two people. This membership can be frozen for $5/mo.

[Purchase a 2-Crew PIF Membership](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/141 "")

#### **2 Person Crew Membership**

Access to full facility including unlimited yoga and fitness classes. Two guest passes a month.

**$160/mo ($80/each)**

Drafts monthly from bank account or credit card. Monthly drafting memberships have a $45 initiation fee, and no cancellation fee. Traveling? There is a $5/mo freeze fee to avoid paying the initiation fee again.

[Purchase a 2-Crew Monthly Drafting Membership](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/134 "")

#### **Additional Crew Members**

**2 Person Crew Monthly Drafting Membership ($160) + $62/crew member**

**3 Person Crew 1 YR Paid-in-Full – $2,350**

**4 Person Crew 1 YR Paid-in-Full – $3,050**

**5 Person Crew 1 YR Paid-in-Full – $3,750**

Paid-in-full crew memberships must be formed completely at the time of sign-up or renewal, and you cannot add a crew member after.

Crews of 6+ members? Please contact [memberships@cruxcc.com](mailto:memberships@cruxcc.com) for rates and set up.

[Purchase a 3-Crew PIF Membership](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/135 "")

[Purchase a 4-Crew PIF Membership](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/143 "")

[Purchase a 5-Crew PIF Membership](https://crux.portal.approach.app/membership-type/144 "")

## Locker Rentals

**Daily Use** – The daily use of lockers is free. If you need a lock, we can give you one in exchange for collateral.

**Long-Term Rental Use** – Members are allowed to keep their belongings in a locker long-term for a $10/month fee.

## Gear Rentals

Gear is not included with membership, but we’ve got you covered! Skip the hassle of renting every time with one of our convenient rental packages:

- **Monthly Rental Package**: $23/month ($18/month with discount)

- **Yearly Rental Package**: $250/year ($200/year with discount)


_Rental gear is included with Team Crux and Rec Team memberships._

## Group Rates

Bringing a group of ten or more? Fill out our form for Large Group Requests to get set up with the best pricing and accomodations.

[Large Group Requests](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScVX9GRvEHAEl_ccU_c13VQ8VQbZMl7QpsaaYAj8KkDKX21wQ/viewform?usp=sf_link)

If you bring in a group of 10 or more without pre-booking at least 2 weeks prior, there will be a $20 fee for your group.

[Discounted Rates](https://www.cruxclimbingcenter.com/discounted-rates/ "")

[Send-What-You-Can Membership Program](https://www.cruxclimbingcenter.com/south-austin/send-what-you-can-membership/ "")

## Legacy Rate Questions

On 10/1/24 we will be increasing Legacy Rates by an average of less than 10%.

**Starting Aug 2022 – Members 2020 rates will be honored as long as you stay a member.  The first round of Legacy Rates from 2019 will be also be honored.** If a member terminates their membership, and decides to rejoin at a later date, they will pay the new rate. If a member freezes their membership, they will get their original rate when they unfreeze.

Paid-in-full members will be allowed to renew their current option (1mo or 1yr) at it’s current rate. If they let their membership lapse for even a day, they will pay the new rate.

**Members rates are the standard rates set out on our website in the [rates section](https://cruxclimbingcenter.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3e0da39e293a1528db965e030&id=1a354981d3&e=606a51a4f3) or [discounted rates](https://cruxclimbingcenter.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3e0da39e293a1528db965e030&id=0a48c48822&e=606a51a4f3) section**. If you have a different rate due to a special discount promotion or a bike benefit pass, you will be able to opt into our current standard rate equivalent once your promotional membership rate has expired. You must opt into this rate without letting your membership lapse (i.e. you can’t come in 4 months later seeking the Legacy Rate).

**Legacy Rates are transferable to any new Crux location.** If you plan to sign up for a membership at our north location once it opens, maybe consider signing up now to lock in a lower rate.

Legacy rates do not include the pre-sale membership rates to Central or North (those fall under discount promotion listed above).
